name: negative-gap-attribution
description: Missing/gap attribution: the shell exec and socket connect occur, but the stdio-redirection (dup2) event arrives far later than the bounded 60s correlation window (ts 260 vs started_at 100 + window 60 = 160). The sequence engine treats the late step as a gap/loss in attribution and marks the sequence uncertain; an uncertain sequence never completes and never alerts (uncertain => no deny/alert invariant). This guards against stitching causally-unrelated events into a false reverse shell when telemetry is late or partially lost. Expect no match.
